incidentScope: Incidents are recalls, market withdrawals and safety alerts from the last 10 years, drawn from three kinds of source, each labelled. Regulator notices come from the CFIA or Health Canada, or from the FDA. Company or trade entries come from a manufacturer's own announcement or from the trade and veterinary press, and name a dated recall. Reports are regulator investigations that name a brand; they are not confirmed recalls and are not counted as incidents. A US notice does not by itself mean a Canadian lot is affected, so check the notice for lot numbers. Recalls that cover only dog food are not included, because dogs and cats have different nutrient needs. Consumer complaints, social media posts and lawsuits are not included. Pet food recall reporting in Canada is largely voluntary, so a food with no entry here has not necessarily never been recalled.

incidentTiers.regulator: Published by the CFIA, Health Canada or the FDA.
incidentTiers.company-or-trade: From the manufacturer's own announcement or the trade and veterinary press. A dated recall that names the product or line.
incidentTiers.report: A regulator investigation or adverse-event summary that names the brand. Not a confirmed recall, and no cause has been established.
